solution:
**Concept**

 
• Navigation within a CNC (Computer Numerical Control) interface requires the use of physical keys on the MDI (Manual Data Input) panel to switch between various display screens.
 
• The **Offset** page is a specific area in the control system where tool dimensions (geometry), tool usage degradation (wear), and work coordinate systems are managed.
 
• To interact with any data field on the monitor, the operator must first ensure the control unit is displaying the correct functional menu.
